Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest - Deep, Dark and Enchanted
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: In the extreme north-east of Norway known as the Finnmark region, winters are freezing cold and snowy. Due to the location on the Arctic Ocean, the roads are prone to snow drifts. Every metre is a challenge and a journey into risk. An adventure for all those who set off into the fascinating and unique landscape, through a seemingly endless desert of snow.

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica - Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Baltic National Parks
programme.desc: Soomaa National Park is one of Europes wettest wilderness areas. Floods, forests and wetlands create a landscape where canoes replace roads during the fifth season.

programme.title: Mambrú se fue a la guerra
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de Franco, Florentina, la madre de una pequeña familia de pueblo, comunica que su marido, al que habían dado por muerto en la guerra civil, está vivo. Durante el franquismo ha permanecido oculto en esa misma vivienda.

programme.title: Hotel Danubio

programme.title: Bombas para la paz

programme.title: La noche que mi madre mató a mi padre

programme.title: Fuera del cuerpo

programme.title: ¿Neuroqué?

programme.title: Cienci héroes

programme.title: El cuco de las matemáticas

programme.title: Escúchame con mamen arroyo
programme.desc: El próximo 27 de octubre se conmemora el Día Internacional del Trastorno por Déficit de Atención e Hiperactividad (TDHA), una efeméride que busca concienciar sobre esta condición del neurodesarrollo de origen neurobiológico. Escúchame! se suma para visibilizar la realidad de las personas que conviven con TDHA conociendo la historia de una familia extremeña y los retos que afrontan en su día a día. "Mi imaginación no tiene límites, mi vida tampoco". Así se define Pepe Mahugo, un pacense con discapacidad física que nos cuenta cómo el deporte puede ser un salvavidas. Nada se pone por delante a este extremeño que lucha por contar con espacios accesibles para que las barreras no impidan el derecho a llevar una vida plena y autónoma. La igualdad implica que cada vez sean más las mujeres que accedan a puestos de responsabilidad. Techos de cristal que rompen mujeres como Maite Berracoso, una cacereña con discapacidad auditiva que es la presidenta de la Asociación de Personas Sordas de Cáceres, organización desde la que trabaja para garantizar los derechos de todos y todas. Estela ha buceado en la web para proponernos cuatro herramientas digitales que facilitan la práctica deportiva de las personas con discapacidad en cualquier entorno, también en casa. Esta semana nos vamos al cine. Os proponemos el documental "Divergentes". El film nos ayuda a comprender la experiencia y la forma de entender el mundo de personas con autismo.

programme.title: 112 en acción
programme.sub-title: Rosario Flores en Plaza Mayor de Cáceres
programme.desc: Unas 15.000 personas llenan la Plaza Mayor de Cáceres para asistir al concierto de Rosario Flores. Acompañamos a la Policía Local durante el dispositivo especial desplegado para garantizar la seguridad del evento, controlar los accesos y coordinarse con Policía Nacional y los servicios sanitarios. También acompañamos a la Guardia Civil en un control establecido en la A-5 para detectar drogas, armas y otros efectos ilícitos. Durante la inspección de un vehículo ocupado por tres personas, los agentes encuentran varias dosis de cocaína en la zona del copiloto. Por otro lado, los Bomberos reciben un aviso para acceder a una vivienda después de que resulte imposible contactar con su propietario. Los efectivos entran a través del balcón y encuentran al hombre fallecido. Poco después, tienen que regresar al domicilio ante la existencia de un posible riesgo biológico.

programme.title: Andalucía a dedo
programme.desc: Andalucía a dedo es un programa de viajes y relatos humanos protagonizado por el periodista Nacho Medina. Con una mochila, un operador de cámara y sin dinero, recorre Andalucía haciendo autostop y dejando que sean las personas que encuentra por el camino quienes decidan el rumbo de cada aventura. Sin guion previo ni destino establecido, cada episodio se convierte en una experiencia única en la que afloran conversaciones espontáneas, historias de superación, recuerdos, tradiciones y vivencias que muestran la cara más auténtica y solidaria de Andalucía. Agricultores, camioneros, familias, jóvenes o inmigrantes comparten parte de su vida con el equipo, transformando cada trayecto en un retrato cercano de la realidad andaluza. Un formato que combina viaje, emoción e improvisación para descubrir la riqueza humana de una tierra donde el destino lo marcan las personas.

programme.title: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions
programme.desc: In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how? Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

programme.title: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time
programme.desc: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

programme.title: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life
programme.desc: Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art. In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named "Duck Poo Fragrance" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional "yum cha" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling "kueh" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people's southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 1
programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN's Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, "Fun Guide to China". Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port. From the world's largest stand-alone duty-free mall - a true shopper's paradise, to the laid-back charm of an "Old Dad Tea" restaurant, host Tianran He explores the evolving cityscape of Haikou. On the northeast coast in Wenchang, he joins a local photographer to witness the launch of a Chinese space rocket, before diving into interactive space museums that bring the cosmos within reach. The journey then heads west to Danzhou, where campervans and "mermaids" share the same stage, before reaching Wanning on the east coast, where Tianran catches waves at one of China's most famous surfing hotspots.

programme.title: A Bite of Dongguan Ep.2
programme.desc: An exploration of authentic urban cuisine, this documentary unveils the hidden culinary world beneath the surface of Dongguan - an international city with a deeply rooted food culture.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the "La'aomen" harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: "Mountain Orchid Rice".

Sin embargo, su riqueza y poder no le otorgan satisfacción, y su ambición desmedida solo le trae sufrimiento, hasta que lo entrega todo, incluso a sí mismo, en nombre del amor. Esta epopeya, basada en la vida real de Varvakis, se desarrolla desde la isla griega de Psara hasta la corte de Catalina la Grande en Rusia y las orillas del mar Caspio, para luego regresar a Grecia, un país desgarrado por la guerra civil y la lucha por la independencia durante la Revolución de 1821 contra el Imperio Otomano.

A principios del siglo XX, China se encuentra en crisis. El país está dividido en facciones enfrentadas, los ciudadanos pasan hambre y las recientes reformas políticas han empeorado la situación. La dinastía Qing, gobernada por un emperador de siete años y su despiadada madre, la emperatriz viuda Longyu, está completamente desconectada tras 250 años de poder incuestionable. Huang Xing acaba de regresar de Japón, donde estudió el arte de la guerra moderna. Al ver a su país desmoronarse, siente que no tiene otra opción que tomar las armas.

Seleccionado entre más de tres mil pilotos de combate de toda la Unión Soviética, Gagarin tuvo que entrenarse rápidamente para realizar el viaje de su vida.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: The case of a gruesome stabbing death of a bullied teenager remains unsolved for 27 years.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: After U.S. Navy sailor disappears in 68, the Navy claims he went AWOL. But his sister works for over 30 years to prove that he was really killed. And DNA from a cigarette butt helps detectives to unravel a 20-year-old case of rape and murder.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: On a summer night in 1987, a 17-year-old girl to come home is found raped and strangled near the Hudson River. And In 1983, a young mother is raped and murdered at work. The crime remains unsolved for two decades.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: While hiking with husband Dennis in Montana, Leslee Larson fell into Wolf Creek. Then Dennis is convicted of murdering his wife, while in Main. And 15-year-old papergirl Penny Parker goes missing, then her body is found by a search volunteer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A videotape made at an ATM machine helps police in Louisville, KY, to nab a man suspected of raping 13 women. And a DA investigator in Georgia helps crack a murder case that his father, a police chief, first worked on 30 years before.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: In 1979 Janie Landers disappears from a home for the impaired--the latest consequence of the facility's history of neglect. When Janie's body is found, there are many suspects but it is years before the killer is found.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Police solve a murder when divers find a skeleton in a car at the bottom of a river, and a dead dog's DNA helps crack open a 6-year-old case.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Work of an Alberta, Canada detective finally pays off when he tracks down the man who murdered a 6-year-old girl 10 years earlier. And when police search for the killer of a hitchhiker, they find that the victim's diary is one of their best clues.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: The longest-running cold case of a law enforcement officer in the United States was the murder of Sheriff's Lt. Joe Clark.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: On February 2, 2010, two masked gunmen commit a violent robbery and shoot Michael Temple Jr., rendering him a quadriplegic for five years before his death. In this unusual cold case, DNA is used to create a sketch of the killer.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A police investigator discovers a letter written 16 years earlier that provides clues to a woman's murder. And a firearms expert supplies the evidence that South Carolina authorities need to put a man on trial in 2002 for a murder committed in 1961.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: A mother is suspected in the murders of two of her daughters when her third daughter finally convinces police to reopen two cold cases.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: With access to the San Francisco Police Department's work, including saliva samples taken from letters the infamous Zodiac Killer sent 30 years ago, we reevaluate the case of the serial killer who began terrorizing California in the late 1960s.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.sub-title: Gone in a New York Minute
programme.desc: In a city of eight million, landlord Bruce Blackwood disappears without a trace in March 2006. Though there is no body, the NYPD is sure this is a homicide and they spend the next nine years searching for answers.

programme.title: Cold Case Files
programme.desc: When a 30-year-old mother fails to report for duty in Virginia, the Army lists her as AWOL. Her family immediately suspects foul play. They embark on a 13-year quest for answers before an eyewitness blows the case wide open.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: Nine years after the murders of a mother and her teenage daughters, a wiretapped conversation helps police to crack the case. And the baffling murder of a Virginia woman is solved when human bones are discovered by a geologist in North Carolina.

programme.title: Cold Case Files Classic
programme.desc: When a church deacon is found shot to death it looks like police may have stumbled upon a multi-party murder plot. And, a wife remains a key suspect in her husband's murder case for six years, until she attempts to prove her own innocence.

Leland Klassen
programme.desc: Raised on a farm in the heart of Canada, Leland quickly learned that shoveling manure and weeding potatoes, although lucrative, wasnít his passion in life. So with absolutely no clear direction or vision for his future, he did what everyone does when they find themselves in that position - he went to University. He wisely chose his classes based on whichever cute girl happened to catch his attention and after several short years of last minute cramming and late assignments, Leland graduated from the University of Saskatchewan with a degree in Anthropology. As you might have guessed, Lelandís university education opened many doors for him in the years to come, but for some reason he was dissatisfied working for a courier as a night shift stock boy. By this time married and with his first child soon on the way, the most responsible and obvious choice was, of course, to pursue a career in the entertainment industry. Starting off at amateur nights and seedy bars Leland decided right from the beginning that he would remain clean despite what everyone else was doing and as a result over the last 16 years Leland has become recognized as Canadaís premier clean comedian. With his unique intelligence and wit, Leland has carved out quite a niche for himself in the world of entertainment. Using his farm boy charm and handsome (although somewhat inbred) Mennonite good looks, Lelandís clever observations and rich life experiences are brought to life in a one-of-a-kind show. LELANDíS CREDITS: Halifax Comedy Fest 2014, Just for Laughs in Montreal, 1999, 2001, 2004 and 2014, Host of Popcorn TV, Featured on Thou Shalt Laugh 5, Host of Comedy Tournament, Co-Host GMA Canada 2009, 2012 and 2013, Promise Keepers Canada, Episode of the US syndicated comedy series ìBananasî, Two of his own television seriesí on the West Coast, as well as Appeared on numerous other programs across the United States and Canada, such as Comedy Network, CBC Television, YTV, Star TV, Global and Discovery Kids.

programme.title: Steve Soelberg
programme.desc: Extremely funny comedian and overall nice person Steve Soelberg brings an observational, story telling style of comedy which has repeatedly left his regularly sold out audiences in stitches. Whether he's relating the experiences of growing up in a large family in Seattle, Washington or recounting the time he saw an angry guy in a tutu at a Ragnar relay, he has a way of making each audience member feel as if they were just the person he wanted to tell the story to because he knew they'd enjoy it just as much as he did. Due to his growing popularity as a comedian, he has appeared multiple times on local TV affiliates (Fox, KUTV, and KSL), on the radio, and has entertained tens of thousands traveling the country not only as comedian, but also as the voice of the Ragnar relay races as their race announcer and emcee. Steve's positive, upbeat personality paired with his observational, often self deprecating humor and his ability to appeal to a broad audience guarantee his shows will be a hilarious and memorable experience for all those who attend.

programme.title: Erica Rhodes
programme.desc: Erica Rhodes is a regular panelist on Comedy Central's @midnight and Fox's Punchline. She has made appearances on SeeSo's The Guest List, Hulu's Coming to the Stage, AXS' Live at Gotham and the syndicated Comics Unleashed. Erica has performed at San Francisco Sketchfest, the Moontower Comedy Festival (Austin, TX), the Blue Whale Comedy Festival (Tulsa, OK), the Boston Comedy Festival and RIOT LA Fest. Recent TV credits include ABC's Modern Family, HBO's Veep, Fox's New Girl, and IFC's Comedy Bang Bang. Erica stars in Audible's Dr. Katz: The Audio Files and ABC Digital's The Off Season. She recurs on TruTV's Fameless and has been a semi-regular performer/writer on NPR's A Prairie Home Companion.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Shot Thru The Heart
programme.desc: The guys learn from Willie that John Luke is going through his first break up. In order to make him feel better the men decide to take John Luke hunting for nutria, and impart their relationship wisdom.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Here Lizard, Lizard
programme.desc: When the warehouse guys new office pet (a lizard) escapes, they try all they can in order to catch the wily reptile. Proving impossible, the guys finally decide to bring in the big guns to help trap it--Mr. Phil Robertson.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Hallu-Si-Nations
programme.desc: With Willie out-of-town, the guys decide to flake off work and leave to brush up the duck blinds on the Robertson land. While out, Si believes he spots what he thinks is the infamous 'Black Panther'.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Let's Go Hunting, Deer
programme.desc: Willie and Jase invite Korie and Missy along on a deer hunt because they believe their wives have become too "city." At Phil and Kay's, Miss Kay decides she wants to frame Phil's original blueprints from the first duck call he created.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Tickets To The Fun Show
programme.desc: During Duck Commander's "Casino Night" party, Si Robertson wins the grand prize of $2000 and decides to buy a massage chair for the duck call room. The massage chair becomes a detriment to the workflow, so Willie takes Si around for a replacement prize.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck Be a Lady
programme.desc: Sadie, has a homecoming dance coming up, but Willie doesn't approve of her dress selection. Willie decides to take Sadie out to find her a new "appropriate" dress.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Ring Around the Redneck
programme.desc: Though Jase lost his wedding ring long ago, Missy decides it's time for Jase to replace it with a new one. When Jase is duck hunting, once again, he loses the ring.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Bass Man Standing
programme.desc: The Duck Commander team is invited to unveil a wing of the local Bass Pro shop that will feature their products.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Battle of the Brothers
programme.desc: Willie's suspicious behavior from dyeing his beard to buying a new motorcycle, makes Jase come to the conclusion that Willie is having a mid-life crisis.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: So You Think You Can Date?
programme.sub-title: So You Think You Can Date?
programme.desc: After discovering that Martin has to miss a Friday night poker game for a date, the guys (as well as their wives) take turns figuring out the best way to coach him for romance. When babysitting for Jep and Jessica turns into a rocky road.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Hot Tub Grime Machine
programme.desc: The guys realize that Godwin has never really asked them for a favor, even though they are all always helping each other out. Godwin asks them to help him get a hot tub, so they set out to help him pick one up.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: A-Jase-ent Living
programme.desc: Due to construction at Jase and Missy's house, Willie and Korie invite Jase and the kids to live with them while Missy is out of town visiting friends. Then, what begins in the duck call room as a series of "Gentlemen's Bets".

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Termite Be a Problem
programme.desc: Because of a termite problem at Duck Commander, the guys are forced to find a different location to work from - Godwin's House. But while at Godwin's house, Godwin gets a taxidermied gift from a past relative.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: John Luke After Dentist
programme.desc: John Luke and Sadie are getting some dental work done, complete with sedation, and it's up to Willie and Korie to take care of them through the process - including getting them back home safely.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Scoot Along Si
programme.desc: Si shows up to work on a mobility scooter, claiming to have an invisible injury from a fender bender with Willie. After losing her beloved turtle "Mr. T", Ms. Kay enlists Phil on a mission to find a new pet turtle.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Jerky Boys
programme.desc: A decision to try and make some duck jerky leads the boys to Godwin's garage and a minibike race. Phil and Kay have made Willie the executor of their will, and Phil wants to show Willie what he and his brothers will inherit when he and Kay pass away.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Going Si-ral
programme.desc: Si discovers Youtube, and, after watching a series of instructional videos, decides he can make something better. John Luke totals Willie's truck, and Willie realizes he may be raising the two worst drivers in all of Louisiana.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Quack-O-Lantern
programme.desc: The Robertsons host a Halloween event at Duck Commander, where they all come together to transform the warehouse into a "scarehouse." Everyone dresses up and Willie desperately tries to be the scariest, but none of the kids are afraid of him.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: O Little Town of West Monroe
programme.sub-title: O Little Town of West Monroe
programme.desc: The Robertsons perform a live nativity for their Church for Christmas, so the wives organize rehearsals to ensure that they pull off a great event. However, rehearsals get off to a bumpy start as the guys can't stop sharing their opinions.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Boomerang Becca
programme.desc: When Rebecca returns home from her internship in Los Angeles, the Robertson family plans a big surprise party to welcome her back. Meanwhile, when Uncle Si gets sick, he seeks the help of Ms. Kay to take care of him.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Willie's Number Two
programme.desc: When Willie is looking to hire a new assistant, Korie insists he interviews her cousin, JD. Meanwhile, when Uncle Si spends the day over at Phil and Kay's, Jep stops by with the kids to keep them away from Jessica, who has taken ill.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Life of Si
programme.desc: After seeing footage Jep shot using a GoPro, Si decides he wants to use the camera to record a day in his life. But when Si gets on the guys nerves while they're hunting, they kick him and his GoPros out of the blind.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: From Duck 'til Dawn
programme.desc: When the duck guys have to pull an all-nighter to finish some work, Willie decides he wants to join them. But when a dying smoke detector distracts them from their work, Jase and Willie head off to disarm it.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Burger Commander
programme.desc: After visiting a popular burger restaurant, Willie and Jase get into a debate over which of them cooks the best burger, prompting them to challenge one another to a cooking contest.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: G.I. Si
programme.desc: When Willie and Jase argue over an old G.I. Joe toy, it leads them into a debate over who would make a better soldier. To settle the score, Willie and Jase head out to the woods with their friends and children for a paintball match.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Jase and the Argonauts
programme.desc: When Willie gets a soft serve machine for himself, he tells the guys they can't use it until they're done working. But when Jase thinks this is unfair, he takes matters into his own hands and finds a better object to use as motivation.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Fowl Playhouse
programme.desc: When Jase finds out Jep is planning to buy his kids a fancy playhouse from a catalogue, he and the guys decide to build one for Jep themselves. But the playhouse ends up looking more like a military-style duck blind.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: The Big LeCOWski
programme.desc: When Sadie spends the day at Duck Commander for a school project, the guys try to show her the ins-and-outs of how a successful company works. But when Willie questions Jase's ingenuity in creating new products they get into a debate.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: The Robertson family pulls together a family reunion to give Mia a big send-off before her surgery.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Governor's Travels
programme.desc: When the Governor of Louisiana announces that he will be coming to Duck Commander to present Willie with a commerce award, John Luke volunteers to give the introduction speech.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Quack and Gown
programme.desc: With Reed's graduation day approaching, Jase decides to take Reed frog hunting the night before, like he did on the day of his own graduation. Willie and Si join in, and Jase tries to keep them from imparting their "college advice" on Reed.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Hands on a Woodchipper
programme.desc: When Willie agrees to sponsor Mountain Man's radio contest, a "Hands on a Hardbody" competition, he somehow finds himself competing against Si for Mountain Man's last minute prize: a woodchipper.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Quack Draft
programme.desc: When the Robertsons participate in the West Monroe Fire Department pancake breakfast, the firemen invite Willie and his brothers to train with the department for the day. Meanwhile, Phil and Si accompany Miss Kay on a trip to visit a family grave.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Brand of Brothers
programme.desc: When Willie contemplates re-branding the Duck Commander image, Jase takes issue with having an outsider design their image, so he and the guys create their own new logo and business cards. Meanwhile, Willie and Phil help Bella with her science project.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: De-Bug Life
programme.desc: The guys realize it is time for the annual cleaning of the duck blinds when they come across a gator using one as a home. Meanwhile, while the kids are running the church car wash, Si and Willie disagree on the best way to draw in customers.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Men vs. Wild
programme.desc: Brotherly competition is taken to a whole new level when Jase and Willie challenge Alan and Jep to a survival race through the woods on Phil's property. Meanwhile, Si is interested in finding a new hobby when he sees Kay cutting coupons.

programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained
programme.desc: A pilot records a fleet of glowing UFOs over the South China Sea that appear and disappear 12,000-year-old carvings at Karahan Tepe depict humanoids with mysterious features.

programme.title: American Monster Files
programme.sub-title: Skinwalker: The Howl of the Rougarou
programme.desc: In the American South, legends tell of a creature haunting the swamps, an ancient evil known as the Rougarou.

programme.title: American Monster Files
programme.desc: A wave of werewolf sightings in western Pennsylvania draws Ward Hiney and skeptic Chad Christy to investigate.

programme.title: American Monster Files
programme.desc: In 1966, a slew of terrifying encounters and paranormal events bedeviled a rural community in West Virginia.

programme.title: American Monster Files
programme.desc: Follow the urban myth about a red-eyed creature seen as a harbinger of doom in the 1960s rural West Virginia.

programme.title: La que se avecina

programme.desc: Victoria Rafaela Balmaseda de Unzeta y Téllez-Girón quiere celebrar su cumpleaños por todo lo alto y un golpe del destino hará que Bruno sea su principal aliado en la organización de los festejos de su aniversario. Además, Antonio recibe una llamada de un compañero de prisión en la que le pide ayuda para que se ocupe de su suegra.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Unos pitufos terroristas, un pajarraco triste...
programme.desc: Enrique Pastor se ve obligado a ofrecer su apoyo a Mª Teresa la alcaldesa en el plano personal, ya que se quedará en su apartamento, después de enterarse de que su marido, ministro del Interior, le pone los cuernos. Por otra parte, Teodoro, el hermano de Amador, viaja a la capital para ganarse la vida como DJ. Su objetivo es lanzar un tema discotequero compuesto por los dos hermanos.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un anillo, una reconciliación y un engendro...
programme.desc: Desesperado por la fuerte caída de las ventas y la escasez de clientela, Antonio Recio busca la manera de levantar su negocio a toda costa. Para ello, el mayorista de pescado decide unilateralmente colocar un cartel publicitario de Mariscos Recio a la entrada de la urbanización. Las dimensiones y aparatosidad del cartel suscitan el malestar de los residentes de Mirador de Montepinar, que reclaman medidas urgentes a Judith y Enrique. Entretanto, un anciano millonario contrata a Amador como chofer de su querida esposa. En su primera jornada laboral, el Cuqui descubre, para su sorpresa, que la mujer para la que trabajará no es una señora de avanzada edad, sino una sofisticada ex modelo llamada Victoria. Mientras su adinerado esposo está volcado en sus negocios, la atractiva joven no duda en utilizar al ex de Maite para paliar su soledad.

programme.title: ¡Toma salami!
programme.desc: Programa de nostalgia televisiva en el que el humorista Javier Capitán, como voz en off, rememorará los grandes momentos televisivos de los canales del grupo.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso) no está pasando por su mejor momento y su mal carácter comienza a afectar al resto de la familia. Cuando conoce a Oswaldo (Joel Angelino), el humor de Eugenia comienza a cambiar positivamente, pero Aida (Carmen Machi) desconfia de las intenciones del chico... Aida le recomienda a su hija Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) un vestido de princesa para asistir a una fiesta de disfraces a la que ha sido invitada. Avergonzada solo de imaginarse con ese atuendo, Lorena recurre a Paz (Melanie Olivares) para que le aconseje. El disfraz finalmente elegido provocará un gran enfado en Aída. Chema (Pepe Viyuela) intenta que no abran un centro comercial en el barrio recogiendo firmas de los vecinos. Mauricio (Mariano Peña) duda en cambiar de opinión sobre la apertura del centro comercial cuando le ofrecen una oferta tentadora...

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Tras encontrar unas revistas pornográficas que cree que son de Jonathan (David Castillo), Aida (Carmen Machi) cree que es mejor que sea hombre quien le hable a su hijo sobre sexo y decide recurrir a su hermano Luisma (Paco León). Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) quiere hacerse un piercing. Ante la negativa de su madre, Jonathan se ofrece a ayudarla buscándole a alguien que se lo haga. Paz (Melanie Olivares) está siendo acosada por Esteban (José Luis García Pérez), uno de sus clientes. Cuando se lo cuenta a Chema (Pepe Viyuela) y a Luisma, éstos no dudan en ayudarla, pero acaban haciéndoselo pagar a la persona equivocada... Mauricio (Mariano Peña) y Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso) juegan juntos a la lotería. Chema quiere unirse pero ellos rechazan la participación del tendero...

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Soraya (Miren Ibaguren) y Chema (Pepe Viyuela) se sienten en deuda con sus amigos Paz (Melanie Olivares) y Edu (Eloy Azorín) y quieren invitarles a una cena. Sin embargo, la humilde pareja siente que su baja economía no puede cubrir los exquisitos gustos de Paz y su marido e intentar arreglar la situación. Cuando Mecos (Adrián Gordillo) les arregla la televisión a Lore (Ana María Polvorosa) y Jonathan (David Castillo), los hermanos no quieren pagarle pero el chico no deja que las cosas se queden así. Mauricio (Mariano Peña) se ve obligado a asistir a la autoescuela para recuperar el carné de conducir tras perder todos los puntos. Allí gozará de la compañía de Fidel (Eduardo Casanova). Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso) demuestra que el estilo de vida de un gordo no es digno de burla.

programme.title: Aída
programme.desc: Mauricio (Mariano Peña) ve como la nueva Ley Antitabaco hace reducir considerablemente la clientela del bar Reinols. Ante esta situación, el hostelero decide echarle un pulso a la Ley y permitir fumar en su bar. Luisma (Paco León) se muestra emocionado después de que Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso), Soraya (Miren Ibaguren), y Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa) le den la noticia de que tiene un hermano gemelo viviendo en Argentina Paz (Melanie Olivares) se ve en una situación complicada cuando, tras haberle asegurado a su marido que sabe esquiar, Edu (Eloy Azorín) organiza un viaje a los Alpes. Con este panorama, la ex de Luisma se ve obligada a aprender a esquiar y Jonathan (David Castillo) se ofrece a darle clases. Macu (Pepa Rus) está con un chico inglés. Su ilusión se ve minada cuando por problemas de idioma, la comunicación se hace imposible, así que la sobrina de Mauricio le pide ayuda a su amigo Fidel (Eduardo Casanova).

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una pretty yonqui, una salchicha a la americana y un salami acostado
programme.desc: Amador acude a un grupo de terapia, dirigido por una reputada psicóloga (Alaska), para tratar su adicción al sexo. Allí comparte sus experiencias con otros adictos, como Luz (Elia Galera) y Covadonga (Bibi Fernández). Además, llega a la urbanización Chusa (Paz Padilla), la ex de Coque, que tiene la oportunidad de reinsertarse en la sociedad tras ganar el Gordo de la Lotería de Navidad.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un churumbel, una lobotomía romántica y una brutal gore experiencia
programme.desc: Presionado por Maite para que encauce su vida, Amador tratará de hacer fortuna en el bingo junto a Fermín, que desea ganar dinero fácil para poder comprar un karaoke. Allí conocerán a la horma de su zapato: Sonsoles, una mujer aficionada al bingo que encadenará continuas victorias en la sala de juego. Determinados a acabar con la buena racha de su rival, el Cuqui y el padre de Lola pondrán en marcha un desesperado y arriesgado plan. Además, Mª Teresa, la alcaldesa de la localidad de la que Pastor es concejal de Juventud y Tiempo Libre, decide abandonar su hogar tras el fracaso de su matrimonio con Alejandro para refugiarse en casa de Enrique, el único hombre en el que confía

programme.title: El Pueblo
programme.desc: El grupo de urbanitas trata de convencer al alcalde para que apruebe nuevas ordenanzas que les permitan llevar una vida más fácil en Peñafría. Aunque Cándido desea fervientemente que todos los habitantes del pueblo sean felices, algunas de las propuestas entran en conflicto con las arraigadas costumbres de los lugareños. Por otra parte, Macarena comienza a aceptar su nueva vida en la aldea y decide pasar más tiempo con Pablo, suscitando el recelo de Laura, su madre.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una vedette molesta, un león peón y un pescadero
programme.desc: Estela ("la Reynolds") contrata a dos obreros gays para reformar el Bajo A sin pedir permiso a la comunidad, lo que desata la indignación de sus vecinos, que intentarán sabotear la remodelación. Por otro lado, Berta, aconsejada por Araceli, decide plantarle cara a Antonio pidiéndole el divorcio.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.desc: Después de ponerse al frente del bar, Fermín decidió hacer una improvisada fiesta de "Halloween" que iba a tener un final terrorífico. La burundanga corría de forma clandestina e hizo perder el control a algunos de los invitados, en especial a Recio y Antonio, que se despertaron al día siguiente en la cama juntos, desnudos.

programme.title: Lo dejo cuando quiera
programme.desc: Pedro, Arturo y Eligio llevan toda su vida centrados en el estudio y sin tiempo para una buena juerga. Ahora, con más de 30 años, sobreviven como pueden con trabajos basura.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Una presidenta capacitista, un mayorista deconstruido y un intercambio epistolar
programme.desc: La vida se ha complicado para Agustín y Amador desde que se han mudado al edificio de Contubernio 49. Ambos se unirán en la cruzada de buscar la manera de que la comunidad instale un ascensor en el inmueble. Mientras tanto, Bruno finge estar enfermo para tratar de eludir el acoso de la marquesa Victoria Rafaela, pero ella no se da por vencida. Por otra parte, cuando Berta encuentra trabajo obliga a Antonio a que deje a un lado su plan de reflotar su imperio empresarial y se haga cargo de las tareas de la casa.

programme.title: Sportium Game Show
programme.desc: Espacio en el que se repasan las mejores estrategias de juego para las diferentes apuestas deportivas.

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Unas mariposillas, una multiorgásmica y una varicela asesina
programme.desc: Los Recio han contratado a una wedding planner para organizar su enlace, después de que Antonio, incapaz de soportar la abstinencia sexual con la que lo había castigado, aceptara volver a casarse con Berta. Pero no todo va a ser tan fácil,cc. Además, los habitantes de Mirador de Montepinar deben ponerse en cuarentena ante el aumento del número de casos de varicela. Por otra parte, la alcaldesa María Teresa recibe la visita de su marido, el ministro del Interior, que pretende arreglar su matrimonio. Las chicas compiten por el puesto de escolta de la regidora. Maite intenta ganarse la vida escribiendo relatos "porno".

programme.title: La que se avecina
programme.sub-title: Un controlador, una nueva Maite y una fisura anal
programme.desc: Determinado a vivir una noche de lujuria y pasión, Antonio invita a Coque a salir de marcha con él. Poco después, el mayorista queda impactado ante la visión de una impresionante dama que camina por la calle y se lanza a su conquista.

programme.title: Aída
programme.sub-title: El cartero sólo llama una vez y a veces, ni eso
programme.desc: Aida (Carmen Machi) es sorprendida por su madre, Eugenia (Marisol Ayuso) en pleno encuentro amoroso con el cartero, así que decide recurrir a Paz (Melanie Olivares) para que le preste su casa en futuras ocasiones. Luisma ha ligado con Milagros Colmenero (Amparo Moreno), la hermana de Mauricio (Mariano Peña). A pesar de la oposición del hostelero a la relación, Luisma decide no romper con Milagros cuando ella le obsequia con un valioso bien material. Como es costumbre, todo el barrio espera la actuación de Eugenia en las fiestas de Esperanza Sur, y a pesar de que a ella no le apetece cantar, lo hace para demostrarle a su nieta Lorena (Ana María Polvorosa), que ella es mejor cantante que Chenoa. Chema (Pepe Viyuela) anima a su hijo Fidel (Eduardo Casanova) para que actúe también en las fiesta del barrio.

programme.title: El Pueblo
programme.desc: Moncho y Ruth son una pareja de hippies ilusionados con convertir el pueblo de Peñafría en una ecoaldea colaborativa, pero la idea no tiene mucho que ver con la realidad. Entre sus curiosos vecinos destacan: Juanjo, un constructor arruinado, y Amaya, su novia, que intentan adaptarse a las costumbres de esta pequeña 'comunidad'; Nacho y Pablo, dos amigos; Elisa y Gustavo, una madre viuda y su hijo opositor 'eterno'; Cándido y 'El Ovejas', el alcalde y el pastor; Laura y Macarena, una madre soltera y su hija adolescente; Arsacio y María, los habitantes más tradicionales y gruñones; o Echegui, un rockero que busca inspiración, y Chicho, su mánager.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Doctors are puzzled when a two-year-old boy is rushed to the hospital with brain seizures and breathing difficulties. Finally, the boy's sister provides an important clue, raising the possibility of a rare syndrome.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: At the scene of a vicious murder, the killer went to a great deal of effort to wipe away his fingerprints and obscure his shoe impressions left when he tracked blood trails on the floor.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A 6-year-old girl ran and hid when she saw her grandmother being beaten to death, but the man followed, beat and assaulted her. She said the assailant was her uncle, who was later convicted. She recanted her testimony years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tooth or Consequences
programme.desc: An investigation into the murder of Katie Poirier is stymied by the lack of a body. Finally, investigators use a single tooth found among some charred remains to identify her.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2000, Christina Sanoubane was murdered in her Cedar Rapids apartment after moving away from her abusive boyfriend. There are clues at the scene: bloody footprints and DNA from the victim's rape kit.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A serial arsonist starts several fires that cause millions of dollars worth of damage and the deaths of three people. He is discovered, partly through the use of forensic hypnosis.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: On a cold December night in 1993, Rose Larner stopped in a convenience store on her way to her boyfriend's house. She was never seen or heard from again. Rose's disappearance remained a mystery, until a tiny clue is found years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman falls to her death from a cliff overlooking the ocean. Initially, investigators think it was a tragic accident. But after a forensic examination, police uncover a very different picture of what happened.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before the evidence melts away. The shoe leads investigators to Peter Benedict and Frank Lanoue, who are convicted of aggravated assault and robbery.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1999, Susan Fassett was gunned down as she left her church choir practice in Poughkeepsie, NY. After clearing her husband, police turned their attention to Fred Andros, with whom Susan had an affair.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman who was known to have suffered from depression apparently took her own life. But her sister told police that, a year before her death, she said if anything were to happen to her there would be a note in the china cabinet.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1990, Shirley Andronowich's body was found mutilated. Eyewitnesses told police she had a fight with her husband the night before, but forensic evidence proved that he had nothing to do with her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1996, more than a dozen children in Seattle, Washington, were fighting for their lives. Each one of them had contracted a serious unknown illness. After one died, investigators knew the clock was ticking.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a decomposed body is found stuffed in a barrel, it's easy to presume murder. But the body had been placed in the barrel 30 years earlier. One of the few clues was an address book found along with the body.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Forensic scientists use evidence from her bedroom to direct police to a prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Paul Gruber's daughter suspected something was wrong when she received birthday cards addressed from her father, but written in a stranger's handwriting.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: They thought the fire would cover their crime. But one tiny clue, no bigger than a thumbtack, remained. It held all the information investigators needed to put a trio of cold-blooded killers behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to police and The New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people — one for each astrological sign.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1995, San Diego police are baffled by a pair of hands found in a dumpster. Through further investigation, they determine that the hands are those of missing person Don Hardin.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.desc: Hyoma challenges Gingka to a new battle and it's not like it's ever been before...

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion

programme.desc: Emma starts acting weird after pricking her finger on a barb of coral. Cleo’s fish Hector exhibits the same behaviour. Emma becomes more and more like a fish and Lewis has to find a way to cure her.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Lewis and Zane find an old myth about mermaids is true – the scent of ambergris sends them wild. But it backfires when sleazy Nate gets hold of the scent and has all three mermaid girls on his arm!

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Rikki tries to avoid Zane when he comes back, but needs his help after an incident with a speedboat. Meanwhile, Charlotte continues to flirt with Lewis and Cleo worries for their secret.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Cleo and Rikki push Ash into asking Emma out again – little did they know he’d turn up at Emma’s place in time for a full moon! Rikki and Cleo are both moonstruck and Ash looks set to discover Emma’s secret.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: For the first anniversary of the girls being mermaids, Cleo decides to throw a party. However, Emma and Rikki fall out following a fight between Ash and Zane and Cleo may have to celebrate alone.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Charlotte follows Lewis to Max Hamilton. Max tells all to Charlotte when he discovers she’s the granddaughter of his one true love. Charlotte and Lewis almost break up until she goes to the moonpool, becoming a mermaid herself!

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: The girls have to deal with a fourth mermaid who turns out to be a loose cannon; Charlotte almost turns into a mermaid at a volleyball competition. Charlotte discovers she has all three mermaid superpowers.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Cleo is bullied by Charlotte and runs away to the ocean. With Cleo missing, everyone becomes more and more worried. Lewis discovers what Charlotte has been up to and breaks up with her. He finds Cleo and they kiss.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.desc: The queens design and market drag-influenced products. Entrepreneur Marcus Lemonis (CNBC's The Profit) co-stars, and comedian Graham Norton guest judges.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars
programme.sub-title: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars Family That Drags Together
programme.desc: The queens must makeover family members and vogue the house down. Aubrey Plaza (Parks and Recreation) guest judges.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars
programme.sub-title: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars All Stars Supergroup
programme.desc: The winner of RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars is crowned. But first, the queens must write original rap lyrics and perform as the ultimate girl group.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars
programme.sub-title: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars Reunited
programme.desc: The All Star queens reunite to dish about the most shocking, glamorous and sickening moments of the season. Hosted by the Emmy Award winning RuPaul.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race
programme.desc: Nicki Minaj guest judges the new cast of queens competing for $100,000 and the title of America's Next Drag Superstar. The first step toward the crown is having to write and perform an original rap number.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race
programme.desc: In the second season premiere, the queens must write and perform a Fosse-inspired jazz number. Thandie Newton (Westworld) and Swedish singer Robyn guest judge.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race
programme.desc: For the first time this season, someone will sashay away! The queens must flex their comedy improv skills for the new TV show 'World's Worst' - a talent show for people with little talent. Olivia Munn (X-Men: Apocalypse) guest judges.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race
programme.desc: The queens' creativity comes to life when they compete in a pageant of sports-inspired couture, and strutting the runway in three 'ball-themed' looks. Leslie Jones (Saturday Night Live) guest judges.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race
programme.desc: The queens are challenged to take part in TV's longest running drag queen scripted show, 'Gay's Anatomy.' Pop superstar, Normani guest judges.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race
programme.desc: The queens compete in the legendary Snatch Game. Mean Girls co-stars Jonathan Bennett and Daniel Franzese guest judge. Drag queen Miss Vanjie makes a guest appearance.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race
programme.desc: The queens get into the groove in a Queen of Pop inspired musical. U.S. Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and supermodel Winnie Harlow guest judge.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race
programme.desc: The queens must create and market ridiculously extravagant products, for the new drag queen lifestyle brand 'Droop.' Chaka Khan guest judges. Personal trainer Bob Harper makes a guest appearance.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race
programme.desc: It's time for America's first drag queen president! The queens argue in a fabulous presidential debate. Actors Jeff Goldblum (Jurassic Park) and Rachel Bloom (Crazy Ex-Girlfriend) guest judge.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race
programme.desc: The queens must makeover Drag Race superfans. But there's one thing… the superfans have no idea what's about to happen to them. Actress Daisy Ridley (Star Wars) guest judges.

programme.title: RuPaul's Drag Race
programme.desc: The queens must create and perform their own solo show. Whoopi Goldberg (The View; Ghost) coaches the queens and guest judges.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia
programme.desc: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters, coming face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish and huge blue whales.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia
programme.desc: Complete the trip’s final lap in the untamed lands where Australia’s interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia
programme.desc: Follow the story of Harry and Sally, a pair of little penguins. These flightless, flippered birds create some of the noisiest neighborhoods in nature. Theirs is a family saga of faithful relationships, committed homemaking, and vigorous nightlife.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia
programme.desc: The Emu is Australia’s biggest native bird and is the second largest bird in the world after the African ostrich - two meters tall, with an almost three metre running stride and totally flightless. This bird inhabits a topsy turvy world, where females call the shots, eggs are green and men do all the work to produce and raise tiny babies, known as Stripeys.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia
programme.desc: Australia’s birds of prey are some of the region's fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking; they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australia’s aerial hunters.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia
programme.desc: Meet four birds that go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their chicks. Wherever they live, these winged warriors have got their work cut out.

programme.title: Wild Sky
programme.desc: Learn how South America’s rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforest’s oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the sun’s scorching UV rays.

programme.title: Moon - Nature's Secret Force
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Moon - Nature's Secret Force
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Moon - Nature's Secret Force
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast
programme.desc: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that he’s a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast
programme.desc: Sri Lanka is often described as the jewel of the Indian Ocean – a tear-dropped-shaped island teeming with elephants, unique monkeys and about 1000 misunderstood sloth bears. Little is known about these shaggy bears and Max is here to embed with them and discover not just how they survive in this often-harsh environment (where the monsoon seasons dictate the resources and searing temperatures bake the land) but why they have such a fearsome reputation. Sloth bears are known to attack more people than any other bear species in the world.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast
programme.desc: Max prowls through the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

programme.title: Strange Creatures
programme.desc: Evolution has granted some animals a distinct advantage over their opponents. Investigate the perfect body-part mutations that have given wunderpus octopuses, axolotls, royal spoonbills, aye-ayes, and other creatures an edge.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms
programme.desc: This small park makes a big difference to endangered animals. Offering sanctuary to some of the biggest and smallest animals on the planet, witness how species come back from the edge of extinction to reclaim their place in Africa’s wilderness.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends
programme.desc: A parrot that pals around with a pussycat. A duck that's obsessed with a dog. A young, orphaned deer that has found friendship with a herd of cows. From a wild animal rehabilitation center in Zimbabwe to a centuries-old manor house in Paris to an apartment in Brooklyn, unusual animal relationships are happening everywhere. We examine six remarkable pairings, reveal what makes each partnership work, and discover how these species complement and support each other in fascinating and heart-warming ways.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends
programme.desc: Meet Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends
programme.desc: This episode features a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends
programme.desc: Horace, a lonely vervet monkey who tragically lost an arm but found a family - a pack of rescued dogs. Buggy, an orphaned kangaroo that shares her makeshift pouch with a baby wombat called Wally. Lotus, a sickly mini-pig that recovers after receiving the paw of friendship from a St. Bernard-Bernese Mountain Dog cross named Berlin. Join us as we discover the stories of unusual and extraordinary animal friendships, some brought together by shared tragedy, others by human intervention, and still others by natural curiosity.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends
programme.desc: A troop of old male vervet monkeys in a South African rescue centre has struck up a curious, yet mutually beneficial, relationship with three feral cats.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends
programme.desc: Barkley, a Great Dane that has become a great friend to rescued donkeys and horses at a ranch in California. Picasso, a disabled Pitbull cross that gets a second chance at life thanks to a pig named Pax. Helen, a blind and lonely old bison that gives some motherly love to Italo, a young calf saved from the meat industry. Join us as we span the globe to witness the stories of animals in need of rescue and companionship and how they formed extraordinary bonds with creatures from other species.

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Mekong
programme.desc: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the region’s delicate living networks.

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Mekong
programme.desc: Cambodia is a country that lies almost entirely within the Mekong basin, flanked by Thailand, Laos and Vietnam. The Mekong travels the length of the country entering in the north and tracking south, cutting the region into two halves. Every habitat here is somehow linked to the Mekong’s waters. Whether it be its tributaries which connect and traverse much of the countries terrain, or the seasonal flooding that influences landscapes miles beyond its reach.

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Mekong
programme.desc: This episode follows the seasonal eb and flow of the Mekong through Cambodia: a nation where everything has a special relationship with water. From Cambodia’s diverse wildlife to people living in the stilt villages of lake Tonle Sap, the Mekong has dictated the lives of everything that lives there for centuries.

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Mekong
programme.desc: The final country on the Mekong’s journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnam’s crown, a biological treasure trove.

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Mekong
programme.desc: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

programme.title: Nature
programme.desc: On the southern edge of the Sahara in Fongoli, Senegal, lives a group of remarkable chimpanzees that could hold clues to how we became human. The Fongoli chimps live at the very limits where chimps can survive, having adapted to the extreme heat and dryness of the savanna woodlands. For years, these chimps were elusive ghosts, rarely seen. NATURE traces the remarkable 25-year story of how American anthropologist Jill Pruetz and local chimp expert Dondo Johnny Kante got so close to the Fongoli chimps to uncover unique behavior, including hunting with spears, sheltering in caves, digging wells, and reading fire. Seeing into their secret lives and recording extraordinary new behaviors shine a light on our own evolutionary past and fundamentally change how we think about ourselves.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: Start a new term at the Orangutan Jungle School in Borneo, as newbie Bumi struggles to focus and star student Valentino experiences a bumpy start to college.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: Follow new graduate Beni, who gets an exciting introduction to jungle college alongside former classmates Sura, Meryl, and Wine. Check on new arrival Molly and join Dr. Nadine as she grades slowpoke Bumi and wild child Monita on their latest lessons.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: Shudder as food-obsessed Beni gets a dramatic, educational smackdown from the local dominant male, Petruk. See spoiled rich kid Spanser, a former illegal pet, try to tamp down his sweet tooth before roguish Bumi goes on a wild joyride with Greta.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: Race to contain a case of malaria brought in by orphaned infant Cesia, then assess surrogate mum Sri’s plan to help Bumi. See the positive influence of Daput, a wild orangutan mum, on the college females before a shocking thief raids the food store.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: Hunt for missing nursery-class orphan Lahei and see shy Rumba try her weak left hand in a nest-building session. Watch younger Delilah school Bumi in class, then find out if Beni and Valentino will make the grade and finally earn their freedom.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: Congratulate the new Orangutan Jungle School graduates, following the convoy to the release site where the team bids their friends a poignant farewell.

programme.title: Evolution Earth
programme.desc: Islands are like miniature simplified Earths, where evolution is playing out at superspeed right before our eyes. We journey from the Galapagos to the edge of Antarctica to seek out animals responding in extraordinary ways to our changing planet. We find sealions hunting in a completely new way, lizards changing shape because of hurricanes, and monkeys eating charcoal in response to deforestation.

programme.title: Episodio 105
programme.desc: Fabián y Armando llegan a la casa de Finita los dos totalmente borrachos. Finita ni habla | solamente llora. Armando le llama señora Nevera. Ana sigue quejándose con Mauricio de la actitud de Olegario. Mauricio le da una charla del hombre machista latinoamericano. Olegario y Pastor están tomándose unos tragos y hablando de Ana. Ana le pide a Mauricio que se quede más tiempo con ella pero le dice que su mamá está enferma y que tiene mucho trabajo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Toño desconfía de Nayarí, piensa que tiene algo con Gabriel León pero ella niega todo y termina contándole que Deibis es sobrino de Gabriel, o sea, este y el capitán hermanos. Gabriel le jura a Magdalena que él no tiene nada que ver con las fotos que le llegaron y si no fue un Paparazi desconfían de ambos esposos. Luego ella se siente muy culpable y deja bien en claro que no son amantes, es ahí cuando se larga a llover y León le dice que no ha dejado de pensar en ella. Mientras tanto Marilyn y Angie miran las mismas fotos y esta última se enoja mucho porque ve a su marido con otra mujer. Julieta habla con Valentina para que la ayude a hacer un reportaje a Gabriel León y esta acepta.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín revela que Carero intentó matarlo. Celia sufre una hemorragia y es trasladada de urgencia para una cesárea; Katiuska realiza rituales oscuros deseando su muerte. Marcelo y María del Pilar se reconcilian tras una fuerte discusión por Gustavo. Ricardo acude a la clínica desesperado por la salud de Celia, mientras Manuela se niega a revelarle la verdad. Alejandro decide enfrentar sus problemas en lugar de huir.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto irrumpe en casa de Consuelo y exige llevarse a Natalia, pero ella se niega y él promete vengarse. Marisela exige a Adolfo evitar que Rosa tenga el niño. Alejandro le explica a Carmen Rosa lo del parentesco con Rosa y la convence de ayudar. Junior se compromete a casarse con Rosa pase lo que pase. Rosa decide casarse con Junior contra todos. Eustoquio sigue aterrorizando a Erasto disfrazado. Carmen Rosa duda en revelar el secreto. Consuelo decide ir a hablar con Rosa de nuevo, esta vez con calma. Isaías medita sobre la situación imposible.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe puso en marcha el proceso de denuncia sobre la declaración de Alejandra, y junto a Carlos Ernesto intentan detener a Adolfo y a Rebeca antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Leo y María Lucía están dispuestos a luchar por su unión, hablan con Virginia y Trinidad y enfrentan a Julio después de enterarse de una mentira que le contó a Trinidad. Leonardo nuevamente intenta, en su última oportunidad antes de casarse, de demostrarle su amor a Irene para que ella lo acepte y así detener la boda. La policía detiene a Rodrigo e intenta llevarlo a la comisaría. En ese momento, la gente de Adolfo comienza a disparar para matar a Rodrigo y le dan un disparo. Tony compró un anillo de compromiso y se le declarará a Maribel.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cuando Guillermo y Ana decidieron no dejar a sus respectivas parejas, no luchar por su amor, no tenían idea de que les iba a resultar imposible. Así es como Ana levantada le pide a su madre un poco más de café, por desvelarse toda la noche pensando en Guillermo. Le cuenta a su madre, y ésta sólo le dice que tiene que olvidarse de Guillermo y seguir adelante con Cristóbal. A pesar de lo mal que se siente Ana, toma la decisión definitiva de olvidar a Guillermo, y ser feliz con Cristóbal. Éste por su parte pasa a buscar a Ana para llevarla al trabajo y regalarle flores. Ana le plantea la posibilidad de casarse cuanto antes. Cristóbal toma muy a gusto el planteo Ana, ya que la sentía dubitativa con respecto al casamiento.
