programme.title: Sala 30
programme.desc: Destacado T1 - 7 El cuerpo ha servido al arte casi desde sus inicios. La forma en que esta relación ha evolucionado con el paso del tiempo interesa, y mucho. Hoy se reúnen un colectivo de DJs, un bailarín y dos artistas de la performance para hablar sobre el tema. Maguette Dieng y Baba, de los Jokko Collective, Aimar Pérez Galí, Clàudia Pagès y Joan Morey comparten mesa con Albert Pla y Joan Fontcuberta, un referente internacional, ganador del premio Hasselblad (considerado el Nobel de la fotografía) y maestro del fake. Para un artista, ¿el cuerpo es más que un canal de expresión?

programme.title: Sala 30
programme.desc: ¿Cualquier cosa es susceptible de convertirse en arte? ¿Cómo debemos comportarnos cuando entramos en un museo? Albert Pla vuelve a desayunar rodeado de artistas para resolver esas incógnitas que le bailan por la cabeza. Hoy ha invitado a Josep Maynou, Mireia Saladrigues, Laura Llaneli y Pedro Torres, cuatro artistas con una trayectoria tan consolidada como diferenciada. El lugar de honor en la mesa se lo ha reservado, sin embargo, nada menos que a Dora García, pionera en la performance y el arte audiovisual. Con ellos tocará hablar sobre la investigación.

programme.title: El llenguado
programme.sub-title: El català de totes i viatge a Andorra
programme.desc: Yolanda Sey explora cómo el feminismo influye en la lengua catalana y si un cambio en el lenguaje puede transformar la sociedad. Al mismo tiempo, Guillem Albà visita Andorra para conocer el papel del catalán como lengua oficial en un Estado independiente.

programme.title: La Renaixença
programme.desc: Levantarse de buena mañana y poder hacerse un par de tostadas siempre hace poner de buen humor, si no eres del 60% de personas incapaces de sacarlas antes de que se quemen. Dedicamos este capítulo a la tostadora de pan. Nos visita Sicus Carbonell, uno de los fundadores y miembro del grupo de rumba catalana Sabor de Gràcia, que sube a nuestro escenario para versionar una de sus canciones más conocidas con Arnau Tordera y Laia Glück. Y hoy paseamos a Sara, un pastor alemán de Alella, por la batalla del Castillo Itter.

programme.title: Leo, el guardabosc
programme.desc: Hola, me llamo Leo y soy un aprendiz de guardabosque. Siempre me acompañan mi hermana Katie, que es genial buscando datos con el ordenador, y nuestro perrito, Héroe, que es un explorador infalible. Cada día salimos a explorar y conocemos a un animal nuevo que nos hace aprender cosas sorprendentes sobre la vida salvaje. Muchos animales están en peligro de extinción en los bosques por donde nos movemos, por eso queremos ayudarles. programme.desc: ¡Hola! ¡Soy Dani Jiménez, un loco de la ciencia y de los experimentos sin límites! En "Efecte wow" hemos montado un equipo genial y nuestro objetivo es conseguir decir "wow" en cada experimento que me pasa por la cabeza. Nos gusta hacerlos lo más grandes posible y, si explotan, ¡mejor! Pat es la conseguidora, rondina mucho, pero sin ella no podríamos conseguir lo imposible. Bet, una apasionada de la química y de los cálculos matemáticos, es la científica imprescindible si no queremos morir en el intento. Y Jordi, eternamente hambriento, puede construir todo lo que le pidas... ¡o casi todo!

programme.title: Man 2.0 r-evolution
programme.desc: A lo largo de 4500 años, unas fuerzas invisibles pero increíblemente poderosas han moldeado la vida en la Tierra. Las mutaciones, el flujo genético, la deriva genética y la selección natural: éstas son las fuerzas motoras del proceso de la evolución que ha llevado a la humanidad a ser lo que es hoy en día. Pero en nuestro mundo existe una fuerza aún más poderosa que domina el proceso de la evolución. Es una nueva forma de energía capaz de modificar al hombre, el mundo en el que vive y la esencia misma de la vida; es una fuerza capaz de anticipar el futuro y producir una nueva especie humana. Esta fuerza es la cultura, y su culminación es el progreso tecnológico y científico que nos envuelve y que se encarna en el Homo sapiens 2.0.

programme.title: L'Alícia i en Lewis
programme.desc: Hola, soy Alicia y soy una niña como cualquier otra, pero tengo un secreto que nadie sabe: una clave mágica que me permite transportarme de manera instantánea al País de las Maravillas. Allí vive el conejo Lewis y otros amigos con los que disfruto. También es el reino de una reina muy particular.

programme.title: La abeja Maya
programme.desc: Maya, una joven abeja inquieta, aventurera y preguntona, es enviada por la abeja reina a buscar polen para su colmena. Debe desenvolverse en un entorno plagado de todo tipo de insectos.

programme.title: El Libro de la Selva
programme.desc: Mowgli vive mil aventuras en la selva con sus amigos.

programme.title: Robin Hood, travesuras en Sherwood
programme.desc: Robin de Locksley sólo tiene 10 años pero ya est un héroe, lleno de energía y valentía, que vive miles de aventuras junto a sus amigos tratando siempre de pasárselo bien. Pero todavía tiene que madurar y sus planes no siempre resultan como esperaban. Sin embargo, siempre puede contar con la ayuda de sus amigos para enfrentarse a todas las tretas del Príncipe John.

programme.title: GhostForce
programme.desc: Tres alumnos de un instituto trabajan como un equipo de superhéroes, los Ghostforce, y luchan en secreto contra los fantasmas que acechan su ciudad.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: La Leyenda de Po
programme.desc: Una ola de delincuencia azota el valle, pero el entusiasmo de Po por acabar con el crimen se ve frenado cuando descubre que el culpable podría ser Monkey.

programme.title: El millor en tot
programme.desc: Diez deportistas de catorce años, los diez chicos y chicas mejores de Noruega en su deporte, competirán entre ellos. ¿Serán capaces de aprender un nuevo deporte en sólo dos días? Surf, patinaje, escalada, gimástica rítmica, motocross, salto de trampolín... ¿Quién será el ganador de "El mejor en todo"?

programme.title: Bestial! con Kayne Tremills y Kamil Ellis
programme.desc: ¡Bestial! es una serie documental presentada por Kayne Tremills y Kamil Ellis, que nos lleva a explorar y vivir aventuras por varios rincones de Australia.

programme.title: Mucho Mike
programme.desc: Mike es un bulldog de gustos sofisticados, al que le gusta vivir tranquilo. Sin embargo, tendrá que defender su casa de intrusos que tienen la habilidad de aparecer en los peores momentos posibles: mapaches, tortugas, el gato Fluffy.

programme.title: El Gran Dictat
programme.desc: Presentado por Òscar Dalmau. El protagonista del concurso es el catalán actual, el que hablamos en la calle. Por eso, los contenidos incluyen los últimos anglicismos, tecnicismos o el lenguaje coloquial que está incorporando nuestra lengua.

programme.title: 60 minuts
programme.desc: Programa de reportajes que emite algunos de los mejores trabajos periodísticos a nivel mundial sobre temas de actualidad y de reflexión social.

programme.title: Grans àpats
programme.desc: Serie documental en la que la periodista Greta Georges viaja por el mundo con la intención de descubrir qué implica cocinar, gestionar y mover grandes cantidades de comida.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Antonia escapa del hospital. Lagarto la sigue y termina malherido. Francisca tiene un mal presentimiento y mientras cocina con Cecilia, Antonia llega a su casa y las encañona. Lucho es puesto en libertad hasta que la jueza dicte sentencia.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Antonia y Gabriela se enfrentan en la mina. La vieja patrona le dispara a su propio hijo. Chacón aparece y cumple su venganza. Antonia queda cuadripléjica. Alejandro y Gabriela se casan. Nace Tomasito y trae una nueva esperanza a su hermana Lucía.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Martín le aconseja a Norma que se case con Juan, quien sueña vivir con ella y el niño como una familia. Rosario se le atraviesa con el carro a Franco y él la rechaza, Gabriela pacta con Dínora.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Rosario se propone reconquistar a Franco, lo que ella no sabe es que Armando piensa en acabar con él en la fiesta. A las hijas y al padre de Gabriela les extraña su nueva amistad con Dínora.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: En la fiesta, Franco cubre a Sara con piropos y la acompaña al carro, ella ve cuando lo secuestran. Jimena coquetea con un invitado para darle celos a Óscar mientras Norma confronta a su madre.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Sara arriesga su vida para salvar a Franco de los matones, él le agradece con un beso. Jimena llega a la casa tras burlarse de Óscar y se preocupa por su hermana, a ambas les espera un regaño.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Dínora le inventa a Norma que es novia de Juan, él no se queda tranquilo, busca a la madre de su hijo y trata de aclarar todo cuando otra mentira los separa. Franco pone a Armando en su sitio.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Norma cae otra vez en la farsa de Dínora quien se ingenia una insólita historia con Gabriela de cómplice, Martín sospecha de su hija. Jimena regresa con tropiezos a la filmación del comercial.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Los matones ponen una bomba en la hacienda Reyes pero se equivocan de carro, Franco descubre que fue un atentado en su contra. Martín aconseja a Sara y confronta a Gabriela y a Fernando.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Franco llega al restaurante y Armando queda impresionado, Reyes culpa a Rosario del atentado por perseguirlo. Martín le dice a Norma que Dínora, Gabriela y Fernando quieren separarla de Juan.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Óscar y Jimena alargan su divorcio, él le pide que ayude a Juan, lo mismo hace Franco con Sara, las dos prometen hablar con Norma. Rosario reconoce que su matrimonio es un fracaso.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Fernando se queja con Gabriela de la paliza que le dieron los Reyes, Sara revela que él la atacó y le dice a Norma que su mamá y Dínora buscan alejarla de Juan. Óscar descubre a Eva.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Norma renuncia al consultorio, le asusta la cercanía de Fernando con Juan David, también Ruth se retira de la Casa de Modas por presión de su mamá. Juan se niega a asistir a la cena de Dínora.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Dínora tiene una trampa para comprometer a Juan, pero Franco y Óscar planean otra para ella. Ruth le cuenta a Raquel lo que dijo Calixto sobre su madre y Rosario le pide el divorcio a Armando.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Dínora estalla de rabia porque Juan no llega y su trampa se cae, Franco y Óscar le aclaran que él ama a Norma, quien lo busca en la hacienda. Las Elizondo creen que Martín fue secuestrado.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.sub-title: Con las manos en la masa
programme.desc: Juan y Norma buscan a Dínora, la ven en una vergonzosa situación y ella no puede aclarar lo que pasó, atrapada en su red de mentiras. Gabriela y Fernando le echan a perder la fiesta a Martín.

programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Without A Trace
programme.desc: Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which as mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid the box exploded killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: LA TREPADORA
programme.desc: La Trepadora narra el choque entre dos familias poderosas y orgullosas. Nicolás Del Casal, decidido a recuperar el honor que le arrebataron a su madre, regresa a las tierras de sus antepasados. Allí se enfrenta a secretos, traiciones y al dominio de los Peñalver, la familia rival. - En medio de esta lucha surge Venevita Peñalver, una mujer fuerte, seductora y acostumbrada a imponer su voluntad. Entre ella y Nicolás nace una pasión intensa, marcada por el orgullo, el deseo y la rivalidad. Su amor crece como una fuerza indomable que los une y los destruye al mismo tiempo.

programme.title: Las hermanitas Calle
programme.desc: La familia se apellida Calle. Son 4 hermanas, 1 hermano, la mamá, un tío y los novios. Dos de las hermanas son cantantes populares y consiguen un contrato discográfico, pero todos los miembros de la familia, incluyéndolas, atraviesan situaciones dramáticas. Tienen que enfrentar muchos problemas que no dejan de aparecer. Las dos protagonistas son las hermanas cantantes. Además, deben enfrentarse al alcalde corrupto y malvado, quien acusa falsamente a una de ellas y hace que termine en la cárcel.

programme.title: Las hermanitas Calle
programme.desc: La familia se apellida Calle. Son 4 hermanas, 1 hermano, la mamá, un tío y los novios. Dos de las hermanas son cantantes populares y consiguen un contrato discográfico, pero todos los miembros de la familia, incluyéndolas, atraviesan situaciones dramáticas. Tienen que enfrentar muchos problemas que no dejan de aparecer. Las dos protagonistas son las hermanas cantantes. Además, deben enfrentarse al alcalde corrupto y malvado, quien acusa falsamente a una de ellas y hace que termine en la cárcel.

programme.title: El señor de los bosques
programme.desc: Serie documental que viaja por los bosques de España para mostrar el mundo de las setas con el experto Vicente Sevilla y la compañía de conocidos personajes que nos enseñarán a encontrar, identificar y degustar setas, frutos silvestres, hierbas, flores y los frutos más apreciados que ofrece la naturaleza, además de buenas prácticas de conservación forestal. El programa nos da las pautas para distinguir las setas comestibles y las tóxicas, en un trabajo de prevención. Asimismo, aprovecha la riqueza de las diferentes zonas geográficas en otoño para recoger diferentes frutos, como castañas en el Bierzo, endrinas en Navarra o arándanos en Galicia. Despúes del recorrido por el bosque, el experto micólogo y su invitado buscarán al cocinero Diego Ferrer, que instalará su cocina en un entorno natural cercano. Allí preparará una sabrosa receta en la que aportará lo recogido como parte de los ingredientes.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny returns to South Africa with Caroline, Liv and Charlotte. They are all excited to be back and are looking forward to seeing their new home, Clearwater Farm.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Danny has been preparing his pitch for an Endangered Species Project. JLW, a pharmaceutical company, are looking to fund an environmental project and the family hope that this grant money will enable them to buy Leopard's Den and Mara.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny and Ed release two cheetah brothers together, a symbol of their new partnership, but not all of the family are happy about this new start. Caroline is still furious at what she sees as Danny's betrayal of Du Plessis.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: The family are still estranged following Caroline's decision to move back to the decrepit Clearwater house with Du Plessis. Rosie is determined to reunite everyone, and plans a civilised dinner as a step towards reconciliation.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Danny is in prison, accused of murdering Peeters, but Du Plessis is determined to prove his friend's innocence by any means he can. Du Plessis' first attempt backfires disastrously when he harangues a police officer and ends up in a cell next to Danny.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: With Danny away, and Du Plessis undertaking an ignominious stretch of community service, Ed is left in charge of running the Endangered Species Project.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny and Ed are anxiously preparing for a review with JLW, the pharmaceutical company that fund their Endangered Species Project. They are desperate for it to go smoothly, and as a result are driving the rest of the family mad.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: Following the loss of their funding, the family are in dire financial straits. Danny and Ed attempt to get an extension on their mortgage but are refused. Fiona spurs Ed on, telling him that the man she used to know would have a plan for survival.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 10
programme.desc: Strange things are happening at Leopard's Den. The family awake to find frogs everywhere, seemingly having rained down overnight; the giraffe refuses to budge from the front gate and the cheetah is off its food.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Scabby Monkey
programme.desc: Contending with overweight cats and their over protective owners was not what Danny Trevanion had in mind when he became a vet. So when a scruffy, barely alive African monkey arrives at his practise Danny is fascinated by the challenge.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Year's Eve at Leopard's Den. Alice has returned, but the stress of combining work with caring for baby Bobby is causing tension between her and Danny. Liv is furious that Fatani hasn't told his mother about their relationship.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: Danny is having second thoughts about the wisdom of uprooting his new family and ploughing all their money into a business venture that they know next to nothing about.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Work To Do
programme.desc: A successful giraffe capture means everyone is in high spirits, until the arrival of Evan and Olivia's real father, Simon, throws the family into turmoil.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Meerly Evan
programme.desc: Evan lets the mischievous meerkats loose in Rosie's room to cause havoc. Rosie is devastated when they destroy an irreplaceable photograph of her mother and rages at Evan. She decides once and for all to go back to Bristol.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Evan Meets Elli
programme.desc: Rogue young male elephants are rampaging through Leopard's Den and destroying everything the family have built, so Danny introduces a matriarch elephant in the hope that she will calm them down.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Dawn Feeling
programme.desc: At a typically rowdy family breakfast, Rosie is excitedly looking forward to the arrival of her friend Izzy, whilst Danny is concerned about the rumour of ivory poachers in the area. Unnoticed, Miranda the lion cub pads off into the bush.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: The Trevanions have been living at Leopard's Den for over a year. The wildlife is roaming freely and the family are settled into African way of life. Business however is not good. With an abundance of game lodges competition is fierce.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: After his Duel with Grady, Yusei is willingly arrested by Trudge and Sector Security. Meanwhile, Carly, disguised as a nurse, tries to interview Jack at the hospital. Possessed by the Spider mark, Trudge appears and challenges Jack and Carly to a Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Crow steals a number of Decks at a Security warehouse and plans his escape on a Duel Runner. Meanwhile, Goodwin tells Yusei about the Dark Signers, and Mina and Trudge look into Jack's disappearance.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei has managed to reunite with his friend Crow Hogan, who tells him about some disturbance coming from the inner part of Satellite. Meanwhile, Jack Atlas and Carly Carmine spend the day at an amusement park, unaware that they are being followed by Mina and Trudge.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei, Crow, Rally and the others meet together at Daedalus Bridge, Crow's hideout and Crow tells them the story of the legendary man of Daedalus Bridge. Meanwhile, in town, a baffling incident involving the Nazca Lines disappearing has occurred. Yusei sets his eyes on the backwoods of Satellite, the B.A.D. Area, so he can come face-to-face with a Dark Signer, namely Kalin Kessler, who seems to know Yusei very well.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Dark Signer Kalin Kessler is revealed to be an old friend of Yusei Fudo back in Satellite. However, for some unknown reason, he holds a deep hatred towards Yusei, Crow and Jack. To make matters worse, he has joined the Dark Signers whose plan is to destroy the world. Now, in order to settle things straight, Yusei and Kalin engage in a Duel while using the great picture as a stage.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Dark Signer Kalin Kessler and Yusei Fudo continue their Duel. Kalin then Summons his trump card, the Dark Synchro Monster "One Hundred-Eyed Dragon", hoping to get rid of his former friend once and for all. Also, flashbacks are shown that reveal why Kalin hates his former team.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: The Duel between Yusei and Kalin continues. Yusei Summons "Stardust Dragon" in order to defeat "One Hundred-Eyed Dragon". However, Kalin smirks and holds up another trump card, "Earthbound Immortal Ccapac Apu".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei is taken by Crow to Martha's refuge to treat his injuries from his Duel with Kalin. Meanwhile, Leo insists that the Signers should all collaborate to fight against the Dark Signers and suggests they contact Arcadia Movement in seek of Akiza's co-operation.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: In fear of losing all connections with Jack, Carly continues her investigation into the Signers and Dark Signers. This leads her to the Arcadia Movement, unaware that she has a date with Destiny.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: In fear of losing all connections with Jack, Carly continues her investigation into the Signers and Dark Signers. This leads her to the Arcadia Movement, unaware that she has a date with Destiny.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Carly Carmine, who has been thrown off the Arcadia Movement building to her death as a result of her Duel with Sayer, has come back to life as a Dark Signer, seeking revenge. Meanwhile, Misty Tredwell, after sensing that Carly has fully become a Dark Signer, goes to the Arcadia Movement to Duel Akiza Izinski as she desires revenge of her own. With both Dark Signers ready to wreak both havoc and vengeance, the countdown to the extinction of the Psychic Duelists seems to have begun!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Akiza Izinski is left in an unconscious state after the attack on the Arcadia Movement. Unable to open Akiza's heart, due to their past treatment of Akiza, her parents ask Yusei Fudo for help.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei and Akiza's Duel continues. Akiza continues to inflict pain to Yusei. But despite the pain, Yusei is still determined to bring Akiza out of her sorrow.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Rex Goodwin invites the Signers to his home and reveals to them the secret of the Crimson Dragon, as well as the connection between the Signers and the Dark Signers.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: While the Signers must make their decision to whether or not they must battle the Dark Signers, Crow encounters Lazar in Satellite and challenges him to a Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Crow and Lazar continue their Duel, with Crow still thinking Lazar is a Dark Signer, while the Signers prepare to travel to Satellite to face the Dark Signers.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei and the other Signers visit Martha in Satellite, but Roman interrupts their visit, challenging Yusei to a Shadow Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: Yusei and Roman continue their Duel. Roman pushes Yusei to despair, by revealing information about his past and putting his friends in danger.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
programme.desc: While the Signers decide to fight each Dark Signer on their battle ground, Luna is unexpectedly sent to the Duel Monsters Spirit World, leaving Leo to fight Devack in her place.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi must duel a magical doppelganger of Kaiba. But with his best cards resting at the bottom of the ocean, Yugi must discover a new strategy to survive fake Kaiba’s powerful Blue-Eyes White Dragon!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi defeats Blue-Eyes White Dragon, but there are two more waiting in the wings! Will the real Kaiba reach Yugi in time to help beat this impersonator?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey decides to battle Rex Raptor without his friends’ help to prove that he is man enough to take care of Serenity on his own. But as Rex Raptor’s relentless dinos destroys Joey’s best Duel Monsters, will Tristan’s card remind him that with his friends, he is never alone in battle?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey duels valiantly, but Rex Raptor has unleashed his secret weapon: Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Joey must figure out the secret of Yugi’s gift, the Time Wizard card, without Yugi’s help or he’s taking the next boat out of Duelist Kingdom!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi’s classmate Bakura, possessed by his Millennium Ring’s dark powers, traps Yugi and friends in a Shadow Game where they become the cards themselves! Not only must Yugi battle to avoid becoming a permanent part of the card game, but also free Bakura’s soul from the Millennium Ring’s control!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: The Light at the End of the Tunnel
programme.desc: Pegasus’s hired duelist PaniK cheats Mai of all her Star Chips, and Yugi vows to defeat him and win them back. But when PaniK’s Castle of Dark Illusions enshrouds his monsters in a black mist, how can Yugi defeat an enemy he cannot see?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Despite his astonishing disadvantage, Yugi boldly provokes PaniK: “I’ll finish you in three turns.” Is Yugi bluffing, or does he have the advantage in this battle of wits?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba descends to the kingdom to face Pegasus! Has Kaiba changed since his battle with Yugi, or is he still the same merciless duelist? A battle between Kaiba’s Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Joey’s Red-Eyes B. Dragon holds the answers!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The #1 American duelist Bandit Keith’s gang kidnaps Joey to a secret cave with a graveyard playing field. As Yugi and friends search for him, Joey faces Bandit Keith’s zombie monsters which become stronger as they return from the grave! Joey is all alone in the battle this time!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The #1 American duelist Bandit Keith’s gang kidnaps Joey to a secret cave with a graveyard playing field. As Yugi and friends search for him, Joey faces Bandit Keith’s zombie monsters which become stronger as they return from the grave! Joey is all alone in the battle this time!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey’s last ditch effort, his lucky Time Wizard card, fails against Bandit Keith’s zombie monsters. But as his lucky streak comes to an end, will his improving skills as a duelist and his love for his sister inspire him to victory?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Trapped in the labyrinth cave, Yugi and friends find an alternate exit, but the door is guarded by Pegasus’s Paradox Brothers. Yugi and Joey will no longer be battling solo; they band together in a team battle against the Paradox Brothers! The battle for all the Star Chips and entrance to Pegasus’s castle is on the line!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey pool their strengths and manage to fend off their opponents’ monsters, but things are about to change as the Paradox Brothers summon the almighty Gate Guardian, a monster that reflects all attacks! Is Joey helping Yugi in this duel, or his lack of experience sealing their fate for defeat?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey each unleash their strongest monster, Summoned Skull and Red-Eyes B. Dragon, but their strength pales in comparison to the tremendous power of Gate Guardian. Individually, our heroes have no chance, but they will unleash the greatest power of all: teamwork!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Using the magic of the Millennium Eye, Pegasus traps Mokuba’s soul inside a card right before Kaiba’s eyes! In order to earn the right to challenge Pegasus, Kaiba must first beat Yugi and take his Star Chips. The rematch between Yugi and Kaiba is about to begin!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba summons Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the strongest monster in the game fused from three Blue-Eyes White Dragons! Yugi has lost all his powerful Duel Monsters, but a true duelist never gives up!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi begins spinning a strategy to put Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon to rest, but he must decide whether to claim victory or spare Kaiba his life. Yugi’s heart is split in two!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Having lost his Star Chips to Kaiba and his only opportunity to save Grandpa, Yugi is in a state of shock. Can Téa bring Yugi back to consciousness by defeating Mai for her extra Star Chips and teach Yugi the heart of the duelist?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends enter the castle to discover Kaiba ready to duel Pegasus with Mokuba’s soul hanging in the balance! The power of the Millennium Eye gives Pegasus the ability to read other people’s minds. Can Kaiba defeat an opponent who knows his moves even before he does?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba is helpless against Pegasus’s Toon World deck and mind-reading abilities. As the duel ends, Pegasus imprisons Kaiba’s soul into a card, just like Grandpa and Mokuba! Yugi has had enough!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: T’was the night before the final battle, and many creatures are stirring! Yugi vows to overthrow Pegasus for the sake of his Grandpa. Tristan leads an exploration party to uncover Pegasus’s secrets. While Joey sleeps, Bandit Keith steals from him the card that permits his entry in the final battle!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Under Pegasus’s weighty glare, Yugi is distracted from his duel with Mai. After making foolish tactical errors and allowing Mai to gain a huge advantage with her Harpie's Pet Dragon, will Yugi gather his focus or succumb to the intense pressure?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mai has rebounded from her previous loss to Joey to become a better duelist. Has Yugi learned from his loss to Kaiba, or is the emotional defeat still weighing on his heart? The answer is in the cards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey frantically searches for the card that permits him to enter the final battle, not realizing Bandit Keith has stolen it from him. As he struggles to accept the fact that Serenity will be blind forever, he receives help from a new, and unexpected, friend!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After Bandit Keith’s Machine deck forces Joey to take the defensive, Joey mimics Keith’s battle strategy to metalicize his Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Is victory assured, or does the cheater Bandit Keith literally have one last card up his sleeve?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 1
programme.desc: With his pride in his strength as a duelist on the line, Joey challenges Yugi for the right to face Pegasus. In a battle between friends, a fierce match ensues between the two people who know each other’s strategies and cards as they struggle to keep their thoughts of past loyalties at the back of their minds.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi is shocked as Joey uses the Time Wizard card on him, the very card he gave Joey as a sign of friendship! However, as the two battle each other valiantly and one comes out the victor, they find confirmation of the strength of their friendship that surpasses any duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi prepares for the ultimate battle against Pegasus with the souls of Grandpa, Kaiba and Mokuba on the line. Meanwhile, Tristan and Bakura infiltrate the castle to find the Kaiba brothers, but at this crucial moment, is Bakura turning back into his evil self again?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 2
programme.desc: Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi’s monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi’s soul into a card, just like Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi has found a counter to Pegasus’s mind-reading ability: Yugi switches back and forth between his two souls! Yugi is able to destroy Pegasus’s Toon World, but the duel has just only begun. The next level of the deadly Shadow Game is about to start!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 4
programme.desc: Yugi crumples in exhaustion under the crippling power of the Shadow Game. His friends yell desperate encouragement, but their voices cannot penetrate the sphere of darkness. Yugi’s chance at victory is slipping away, as is his life!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The Pegasus Saga comes to an end, but a new journey is about to begin! Yugi meets a mysterious Egyptian named Shadi who enters Yugi’s mind with the Millennium Key. What are these Millennium Items, and do they hold the answer to the mystery behind the Shadow Games?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends return from the Duelist Kingdom only to meet a young girl named Rebecca who demands that Grandpa return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to her! She’s here to claim back the card that Grandpa stole from her grandfather many years ago!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The two-faced Board of Directors of KaibaCorp trap Kaiba inside a virtual reality game! Mokuba recruits Yugi and Joey to free Kaiba from this ultimate game where losing equals death!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The quest for Kaiba continues with a little help from… Mai? But can Yugi and friends adapt to a virtual world where the rules and strategies keep changing every step of the way?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After Duke’s all-powerful Orgoth the Relentless dices Yugi’s entire cadre of monsters into shreds, Yugi only has one turn left before he loses all his heart points! Yugi’s last hope rests in one final dice roll in the thrilling conclusion to Dungeon Dice Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Jack appears to taunt Yuya over his fear of using his counterpart's dragons in fear of summoning Zarc. Unable to accomplish anything as is, Yuya challenges Jack to a duel while Reiji makes it so everyone can watch the battle.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya finally listens to his other selves and summons all four of his dragons to defeat Jack. However, there is one final challenge before him in order to become a Dueltainer and purge Zarc: his rival and friend Reiji Akaba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba and Yugi compete to summon their monsters to the field, but each is hindered by the other's strategies.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba is able to summon Obelisk the Tormentor, to the field, putting it at odds with Yugi's own Slifer the Sky Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: With the destruction of both their monsters, Kaiba and Yugi are presented with a vision of the High Priest's legendary battle against the Pharaoh. Kaiba believes this to be a mere illusion, but Yugi knows that it is a vision of the past. The duel continues with Kaiba and Yugi attacking with their signature cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba gains a lead in the duel when he summons three Blue Eyes White Dragons. Yugi's hopes of winning come to an end, but receives some encouragement from Joey and stays strong in the game. Meanwhile, Joey's dreams and the ongoing duel cause Joey to awake.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba's final move forces the duelists to use only three cards, forcing to use the best cards in the decks to win the duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Tired of Kaiba's constant ridicule, Joey challenges Kaiba for third place in the Battle City tournament.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey manages to gain one of Kaiba's strongest cards to help him advance in the duel. Meanwhile, Téa – possessed by the good half of Marik's soul – fights Yami Marik for control of the Millennium Rod.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After defeating Joey and taking third place in the tournament, Kaiba plans to destroy the Duel Tower and bury his past forever. Ishizu and Mokuba convince him otherwise, and he gives Yugi one all-powerful card that could give him a chance to defeat Marik in the final duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The final duel of Battle City begins. Yami Marik quickly turns it into a shadow game and sets it up so that if he or the Pharaoh loses, their host's soul will be destroyed. Yugi convinces the Pharaoh not to worry about him and to keep dueling to save Mai, Bakura and the good Marik. Yami Marik quickly discards his Winged Dragon of Ra to the graveyard, planning to revive it. Yugi manages to summon Slifer the Sky Dragon using his three Knights.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik uses Ra's effect to destroy Slifer and revives it once again to attack Yugi. Yugi plays the card Kaiba gave him, Fiend's Sanctuary, to stop Marik's attack. He then uses Multiply in order to summon Obelisk the Tormentor and devastate Marik.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik's good half possesses Tea again and begs Yugi to destroy him along with his evil side,but he eventually weakens and begins fading away as his dark half loses life points. Yugi and the Pharaoh become hesitant to duel, not wanting to harm the good Marik. As he fades away, Marik appears to an unconscious Odion, thanks him for taking care of him and apologizes, wishing that he could take back his cruel actions. In a cliffhanger, Odion is revealed to have been awakened by Marik's apology.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi continues fending off Marik's attacks, holding out until he has the cards he needs to defeat Marik. Finally, he summons Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl and uses them to activate Ragnarok – a spell card with the ability to destroy all the monsters on Marik's field, including The Winged Dragon of Ra that he fused himself with. (The card actually negates and removes all cards Marik controls, at the cost of banishing all monsters to the graveyard that Yami Yugi has.) But Yami Marik claims that if Ra is destroyed (which will leave the good Marik with only 1 life point), then the good Marik will be too weak to resist the power of the Shadow Realm, and will consequently lose his soul. Then, Odion arrives (although he is still weak), and tells Yami Marik that he has come to release his master (the good Marik), although Yami Marik counters this by saying that Marik's good half is almost completely gone, and that he is here to stay.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Odion tries to get the good Marik to resist his evil half. As a result, Yami Marik becomes angered, and attacks Odion with the Millennium Rod, which weakens Odion even more. Odion doesn't give up, despite Ishizu's protests. As Marik continues his onslaught (which begins to injure Odion), Odion tells Marik's good side that together, they had conquered his evil half before, and that they could do it again. Then, he tells the good Marik that since Yami Marik was created by the good Marik's hatred, he has the power to destroy him. As Yami Marik raises the Rod to deliver the final blow, the good Marik disappears from the field, and begins fighting against Yami Marik, who struggles for control over Marik's body, and refuses to be defeated. However, Marik's good half stalls Yami Marik long enough for Yugi to activate his spell card. Yugi's Ragnarok spell succeeds in destroying (and removing to the graveyard) Ra, allowing the good Marik to regain control of his body. However, a sliver of Yami Marik reappears on the field, although this time, he is the victim. Yami Marik tries to convince the good Marik to help him seize the Millennium Items and rule the world together, but fails as Marik has decided to stop being evil and make up for his actions. Marik surrenders the duel to Yugi, which sends Yami Marik to the Shadow Realm, ending the Battle City finals. Bakura and Mai are returned from the shadow realm and Marik is reunited with his siblings, who forgive him. Yugi receives the three Egyptian God Cards. Kaiba then activates the Duel Tower's self-destruct sequence, giving everybody one hour to get off the island before it explodes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and the gang escape from the island in time, but they are forced to leave Kaiba and Mokuba behind. The brothers get away just as the island explodes using the Blue-Eyes White Jet. Yugi's group heads back to Domino City, where they say their farewells and go their separate ways.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Téa shows Serenity around the city, to all the sites of the important duels of the Battle City Tournament, while Joey duels Yugi to get his Red-Eyes Black Dragon back. Téa eventually meets up with Yugi, and they head off for further adventures.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The three Egyptian God Cards are stolen! A terrifying new villain emerges! And, as if things couldn’t get any worse, real monsters begin to appear around the world, terrorizing the population!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: With Seal of Orichalcos, not only can Gurimo have ten monsters on the field at once, but each creature receives a power boost!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Not only is our world on the brink of apocalypse, but an entire domain of monsters is also on the verge of collapse!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The new kid in town drives Yuya bananas when he begs Yuya to be his duel teacher! Unfortunately for Yuya, this blue-haired battler won't give up until Yuya gives in!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya's getting schooled by his wannabe student, Sora! Can Yuya turn things around and teach Sora a lesson about winning, or is Yuya's Pendulum power not going to make the grade?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Still steaming from his loss to Yuya, Sylvio looks to get some payback! But when Zuzu steps in to stop his plans, a mysterious stranger comes out of the shadows to show her how it's done!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: A strange shadow approaches Yuma, which turns out to be Tokunosuke Omoteura, a classmate of Yuma's known for his duplicitous tongue. In the morning, Yuma was reprimanded for a prank he pulled in front of the whole class that he has no memory of causing. As a result, he's been cut off from every one else. Tokunosuke gently says "Let's Duel". With "Baby Tragon" his new Xyz Monster, Yuma might enjoy this duel, but Tokunosuke seems to be planning something.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Tokunosuke steals Yuma's "Utopia", causing Astral to vanish. Tokunosuke wanted the great power of Numbers, and Yuma tries to Summon "Leviathan Dragon" to fight back, but Tokunosuke's Trap Card takes even that away. When Yuma is pushed into a corner with his field, an unexpected monster will become the Trump Card of the Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After having been around a while and having to work with Yuma, Astral's been fascinated by a TV Show Hero named "Different Dimension ESPer Robin". For some reason, Astral feels close and similar to this Robin from an alternate universe. One day, pictures show up with Robin in a fight downtown! Yuma, prodded by Astral, goes with Kotori to where the autographs were taken and meets Robin's actor, a kid named Fuya! But Fuya is a timid boy who doesn't resemble the Robin they all admire in the slightest.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The mysterious person posing as Robin around town was Fuya. Under the intolerable strain of being a hero, Fuya's heart has been overcome by darkness Yuma challenges him to a Duel to save his soul. Robin, however, possesses "Number 83: Galaxy Queen". With it, he proceeds to summon one character after another from the TV Show. At first, Yuma and Astral were amused by this, but due to Galaxy Queen's almighty Monster Effect, they quickly grow impatient. To make things worse, Galaxy Queen, who currently possesses Robin, has taken on the appearance of Fuya's mother.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The Leo Institute is looking to take over Yuya's duel school, and they're bringing 3 of their most dangerous duelists to take down whoever dares stand in their way!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Confusion abound when enemies become friends... and friends become enemies! Yugi and the gang set off on a cross-country trek when they’re asked for help from a one-eyed former foe!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba returns to Duelist Kingdom for a showdown against Pegasus! Wielding his newest whacked-out Toon terrors, Pegasus is ready to repeat his previous victory against Kaiba!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Not only does Alister’s mighty fiend gain attack points for every fiery monster on the field, but it can also take control of Kaiba’s monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: On the way to Industrial Illusions, Yugi and friends are ambushed by a band of motorcycle thugs - until their favorite friend soars to the rescue!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Can this be?! Mai has joined the enemy! Wielding the sinister sorcery of Seal of Orichalcos, Mai unequivocally calculates to trap Joey’s soul for Dartz’s malevolent master plan!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Taking advantage of the arcane abilities of Seal of Orichalcos, Mai coordinates her Harpie Ladies into devastating combat formations!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: With the potent powers of Claw of Hermos, Joey transforms Time Wizard into an almighty... hammer?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Professor Hawkins has discovered startling connections between the world’s chaotic conundrums, the Orichalcos stones and a lost civilization!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Isolated on a steep mesa in Death Valley, it’s a Wild West showdown between Yugi and his fiercest challenge yet: Rafael and his group of guardian monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Dartz’s master plan is finally revealed, and capturing Yugi’s soul is the catalyst to reset the very essence of history!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Using the awesome abilities of Seal of Orichalcos, Yugi grinds Rafael’s guardians into garbage... but he’s also slowly succumbing to the card’s evil influence!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Dartz has captured Yugi’s soul! Having betrayed his dearest friend, the Pharaoh sinks into the darkest depths of despair and loses his will to save the world!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El tramposo Larva Subterráneo teje una red de mentiras para atraer a Joey a un duelo desigual. Larva Subterránea infecta en secreto el mazo de Joey con un parásito que le impide invocar monstruos fuertes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey aplasta al Gran Moth Definitivo Perfecto, pero Larva suelta a la feroz Reina de los Insectos, la joya de la corona de los insectos que aumenta su fuerza con cada oruga que canibaliza. ¿Conseguirá la reina devoradora de Larva someter a Joey?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba se enfrenta a Gozaburo -y a sus propios demonios- para intentar conquistar por fin su doloroso pasado, pero ¿cómo podrá Kaiba derrotar a la Exodia Necross de Gozaburo, que no puede ser destruido por hechizos, trampas o ni siquiera ataques?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: De vuelta en Ciudad de la Batalle: Parte 1
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos llegan a la isla de KaibaCorp, donde los finalistas de la Ciudad de la Batalla competirán en la arena de duelo definitiva, la majestuosa Torre del Duelo que se extiende cientos de metros en las nubes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: De vuelta en Ciudad de la Batalle: Parte 2
programme.desc: Honor, amistad, venganza... Mientras cada uno de los duelistas recuerda por qué está luchando, la batalla real se desata y ninguno de los duelistas sabe de dónde vendrá el próximo ataque.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: De vuelta en Ciudad de la Batalle: Parte 3
programme.desc: Joey ha librado algunos de los combates más encarnizados de la Ciudad de la Batalla, pero ¿le ha enseñado todo su entrenamiento en primera línea a convertirse en un duelista de élite, o sigue estando por debajo de los tres grandes de Duelo de Monstruos?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik atrapa a Joey en un Juego de Sombras en el que el corazón de cada duelista está vinculado a sus monstruos... ¡Literalmente! Cada vez que un monstruo recibe daño, ¡el duelista siente el dolor en su lugar!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El Helpoemer de Marik no solo envía las cartas poderosas de Joey al cementerio antes de que él pueda utilizarlas, sino que además, Joey sufre dolor por cada monstruo que va al cementerio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Atrapado y a punto de morir, Joey cree que este duelo no puede empeorar. ¡Pero Marik tiene todas las piezas para invocar al Dragón Alado de Ra! ¿Podrá Joey evitar que Marik invoque la carta del dios egipcio o simplemente la victoria no está en las cartas?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es la revancha que todos estábamos esperando. Yugi y Kaiba se enfrentan por primera vez desde el Reino de los Duelistas ante miles de ávidos fans para ganar el derecho a desafiar a Marik. ¡Es la hora del duelo!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es la revancha que todos estábamos esperando. Yugi y Kaiba se enfrentan por primera vez desde el Reino de los Duelistas ante miles de ávidos fans para ganar el derecho a desafiar a Marik. ¡Es la hora del duelo!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba combina la amenaza magnética XYZ-Cañón del Dragón para obtener un poder de ataque inigualable, pero Yugi solo tiene un humilde Caballero de la Reina para protegerse.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡La batalla entre los dioses egipcios ha comenzado! Slifer el Dragón del Cielo de Yugi va a enfrentarse a Obelisco el Atormentador de Kaiba, ¿qué ocurrirá cuando dos dioses egipcios luchen entre sí? ¡Es hora de averiguar qué Dios egipcio es más fuerte!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El enfrentamiento de los dos dioses egipcios libera energías místicas que muestran a Yugi y Kaiba visiones del antiguo pasado egipcio. ¿Qué nuevas respuestas desvelan estas imágenes y qué profecías hacen para el futuro?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba invoca tres poderosos Dragones Blancos de Ojos Azules, pero a Yugi no le queda ningún monstruo en el mazo que pueda resistir su poder. ¿La derrota de Yugi es inminente o una carta de un amigo caído le ayudará a cambiar las tornas de la batalla?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba no solo controla al Dragón Definitivo de Ojos Azules, el monstruo que utilizó para derrotar a Yugi en el Reino de los Duelistas, sino que su carta de Órdenes de Ataque Final deja a Yugi con solo tres cartas en su mazo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La batalla por el bronce: Parte 1
programme.desc: Cansado de los insultos de Kaiba, Joey desafía a Kaiba para conseguir el tercer puesto en el Torneo de la Ciudad de la Batalla. ¿Habrá dominado Joey suficientes estrategias para acabar con el mandamás o Kaiba machacará a Joey como a un patético cachorro?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La batalla por el bronce: Parte 2
programme.desc: Kaiba ataca con su poderoso Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules, pero Joey no tiene monstruos con los que defenderse. La suerte de Joey se ha agotado. ¡Es hora de que confíe en su habilidad!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La batalla por el bronce: Parte 3
programme.desc: La batalla entre Joey y Kaiba llega a su clímax y el resultado del duelo depende de un último giro de la rueda del Mago del Tiempo. ¿Conseguirá Joey acabar con su mayor dolor de cabeza y enseñarle a Kaiba cómo ser un verdadero duelista?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Es el enfrentamiento decisivo de la Ciudad de la Batalla y el destino del mundo está en juego: ¡Yami Yugi contra Marik! En este retorcido Juego de Sombras, si Yami Yugi pierde, se ira de vacaciones permanentes al Reino de las Sombras.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Marik demuestra que su Dragón Alado de Ra es la carta de dioses egipcios más fuerte al destruir a Slifer el Dragón del Cielo. Ninguna de las cartas de Yugi puede resistir su implacable ataque. Un regalo de Kaiba puede ser la clave para cambiar el duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 1
programme.desc: Yugi se prepara para la batalla definitiva contra Pegaso, las almas del abuelo, Kaiba y Mokuba están en juego. Tristán y Bakura se cuelan en el castillo para encontrar a los hermanos Kaiba. ¿Se volverá a convertir Bakura en su yo malvado?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 2
programme.desc: Pegasus usa la baraja de Dibujos Animados y la capacidad de leer la mente que usó con Kaiba y pone a los monstruos de Yugi en su contra. Yugi pierde la voluntad de luchar. ¿Encerrará Pegaso el alma de Yugi en una carta como hizo con Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 3
programme.desc: Yugi ha averiguado cómo contrarrestar la capacidad de leer la mente de Pegasus: Yugi se mueve entre sus dos almas y es capaz de destruir el Mundo Dibujos Animados de Pegasus, pero aún no ha empezado el mortal Juego de las Sombras.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 4
programme.desc: Yugi se desploma agotado bajo el poder paralizante del Juego de Sombras. Sus amigos le gritan desesperados ánimos, pero sus voces no penetran en la esfera de oscuridad. La oportunidad de victoria de Yugi se está esfumando, al igual que su vida.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi contra Pegasus, el partido del milenio: Parte 5
programme.desc: Pegasus invoca a Perdido, un temible monstruo que consume los Monstruos de Duelo de Yugi. Yugi contraataca con... ¿Kuriboh? ¿La criatura más pequeña y débil del juego? ¿Se ha rendido Yugi o se trata de una última estrategia para obtener la victoria?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La Saga de Pegaso llega a su fin, ¡pero un nuevo viaje está a punto de comenzar! Yugi se encuentra con un misterioso egipcio llamado Shadi que entra en la mente de Yugi con la Llave del Milenio.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos regresan del Reino de los Duelistas y se encuentran con una joven llamada Rebecca que exige que el abuelo le devuelva el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Ha venido a recuperar la carta que el abuelo le robó hace muchos años.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Rebecca cree por equivocación que el abuelo le robó el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules. Yugi debe defender al Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules para enseñarle que lo que cuenta no es el poder de las cartas, sino el corazón que hay en ellas.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Con sus engaños, el Consejo de Administración de KaibaCorp atrapa a Kaiba dentro de un juego de realidad virtual. Mokuba recluta a Yugi y Joey para liberar a Kaiba de este juego definitivo en el que perder equivale a morir.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Con sus engaños, el Consejo de Administración de KaibaCorp atrapa a Kaiba dentro de un juego de realidad virtual. Mokuba recluta a Yugi y Joey para liberar a Kaiba de este juego definitivo en el que perder equivale a morir.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La búsqueda de Kaiba continúa con un poco de ayuda de... ¿Mai? Pero, ¿podrán Yugi y sus amigos adaptarse a un mundo virtual en el que las reglas y las estrategias cambian a cada paso?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos rescatan a Kaiba, ¡pero siguen atrapados en el juego! La única salida es superar al Dragón de Cinco Cabezas, pero en el difícil duelo, ¡Joey, Mokuba y Mai pierden todos sus puntos de vida!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 1
programme.desc: Un nuevo estudiante, Duke Devlin, derrota a Joey en una partida de Duelo de Monstruos, obligando a Joey a convertirse en su sirviente. Duke obliga a Joey a ponerse un disfraz de perro y lo humilla en público, obligando a Yugi a retar a Duke a un duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 2
programme.desc: A cambio de la libertad de Joey, Yugi se juega renunciar a los Duelos de Monstruos para siempre. Yugi tiene un comienzo difícil. Todo empeora cuando Duke revela que ha diseñado los Dados Monstruos de la Mazmorra con la ayuda de Pegasus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 3
programme.desc: Yugi utiliza sus habilidades innatas para el juego para dar la vuelta a la tortilla, pero Duke tiene una regla más que mencionar: Todas las criaturas ocupan territorio en el tablero cuadriculado.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Monstruos de la mazmorra de los dados: Parte 4
programme.desc: Después de que el todopoderoso Orgoth el Despiadado de Duke haga trizas a todo el plantel de monstruos de Yugi, a Yugi solo le queda un turno antes de perder todos sus puntos de corazón.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Un adivino misterioso roba el Rompecabezas del Milenio, y Yugi debe derrotarlo en un duelo para recuperarlo. Sin embargo, no se trata de un adivino cualquiera; es un conocido y formidable enemigo del Reino de los Duelistas... ¿o no?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La misteriosa amenaza que controla a Bandido Keith rompe el Rompecabezas del Milenio en pedazos antes de incendiar la arena de duelos. ¿Podrá Yugi recomponer el Rompecabezas del Milenio y salvar al espíritu antes de que las llaman envuelvan toda la sala?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Se revela el origen de Duelo de Monstruos! Utilizando la magia del Collar del Milenio, la historiadora egipcia Ishizu Ishtar muestra a Kaiba cómo se jugaba al Duelo de Monstruos hace milenios.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El espíritu del Rompecabezas del Milenio ve que han desaparecido sus recuerdos del antiguo Egipto, pero Téa le ayudará a descubrir los misterios de su pasado. El duelista Johnny Steps y sus monstruos musicales del rock interrumpirán su búsqueda.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Un juego mental: Mai contra Marik: Parte 3
programme.desc: Mai se hace con el control del Dragón Alado de Ra de Marik, pero es incapaz de averiguar cómo desatar sus poderosas habilidades.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Fusión de los cinco grandes: Parte 3
programme.desc: Los Cinco Grandes convocan a un dragón todopoderoso que ya derrotó a Joey, Mai y Mokuba en un mundo virtual alternativo.
